Name: FarmNet
Author: LennyTheFreakOG
Description:
FarmNet
[b]A real web browser inside Stardew Valley.[/b]
FarmNet adds a pixel-art Chromium-based web browser directly into Stardew Valley.
Press [b]F2[/b] to open FarmNet and browse the actual internet without leaving the game.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Browse real websites[/*]
[*]Search the web[/*]
[*]YouTube video playback[/*]
[*]Browser audio[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley music automatically fades out while browser audio is playing[/*]
[*]Back, Forward, and Reload[/*]
[*]Address bar[/*]
[*]Mouse and keyboard support[/*]
[*]Scrolling[/*]
[*]Built-in browser caching[/*]
[*]Play WebGL games inside FarmNet[/*]
[/list]Yes, you can actually play games inside it.
For example, [b]JACK'S — AIM TRAINER[/b] can be opened and played through FarmNet.
[heading]How To Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install FarmNet.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load your save.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F2[/b].[/*]
[/list]FarmNet will open over the game.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]Windows x64[/*]
[/list][heading]Current Version[/heading]
[b]0.1.0 — Initial Release[/b]
This is the first public release of FarmNet. More features, improvements, and Stardew-specific functionality are planned for future updates.
[heading]Known Limitations[/heading]
FarmNet is an early release and some websites may not work correctly inside the embedded browser.
Browser compatibility can vary depending on the website.

If you have trouble logging into youtube refresh the page !
[heading]Credits[/heading]
FarmNet is created by [b]LennyTheFreak[/b].
Built using SMAPI, CefSharp, and NAudio.
